preregistration: Written before running this study; within-session registration only.
question: Can the same prepared activation front start two local clocks and memories, and can a preinitialized control source enable a blocked downstream response without runtime intervention?

observation.all_state_audit: Every forward step checked by full inverse, then full trajectory rewound

composition_success: Both fixed readouts have first arrival t=j, exact first window and four-phase projection; no-source complete state stays fixed. Later reclicks remain recorded.

perturbation_family.success: Unchanged first-window and phase criteria, including zero memory before t=j. Failures are not relabelled successes.

clutch_search.control_channels: Coupling.ports[2][0] and Coupling.ports[2][14], fixed before execution
clutch_search.cases: For every preparation test all four (data source absent/present, control source absent/present).
clutch_search.coincidence_success: Only both sources produce target click by gate_j+8, with a >=4-sample first memory run; neither single source produces target clicks through t24.
clutch_search.stored_control_success: Additionally, control-only gate is at rest with (r0,r14)=(4,0) at t=gate_j-1, and its total input to gate channel0 at that time is zero. This isolates a stored gate preparation from direct simultaneous control input.
clutch_search.holdout: If any stored-control case passes, repeat exact preparation at gate_j+4, N+4, L+20 with controller phase unchanged (period-four delay). Same criteria; failed confirmations retained.

continuation: A successful restricted control case needs longer holds, repeated inputs, further phases, boundaries, and independent source-family tests before reusable clutch claims. A search miss is not a no-go theorem.
